title: File-attachment annotations and a CLI host for pencil, stamp and attachments
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-edit --test real_document_annotations and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi annotate add writes pencil, stamp and file-attachment annotations, the attachment extracts byte-for-byte through pdfxi attachments, and REVIEW-003 moves to verified.
notes: Adds add_file_attachment (embedded stream + filespec + FileAttachment annotation) and extends the annotate host with pencil (--ink/--stroke-width), stamp (--stamp-name) and file-attachment (--attachment/--name) kinds.
